metric_definition.evidence_recall_at_k: Per answerable question: matched gold evidence units / all gold evidence units; macro averaged.
metric_definition.hit_at_k: Share of answerable questions with at least one matched gold evidence unit.
metric_definition.complete_hit_at_k: Share of answerable questions with every gold evidence unit matched.
metric_definition.no_answer_accuracy: Share of hard negatives rejected with no final evidence and a non-answerable decision.
metric_definition.citation_correctness: Not measured here; semantic claim-to-citation support requires a generated answer and a separate human or judge annotation.
